fusions.name: Culling Stoop
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Strikes a target up to 8 tiles away: it deals 18 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mobbing Flight
fusions.desc: A pass that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Hover and Dart
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Strafing Pass
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a sting leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
